body.heading: About this sheet
paragraphs: Free SparkKindly Kids story sequencing cards printable: Put the Story in Order 14.
Story cards to put in order — beginning, middle and end — and then retell aloud in your own words.

body.heading: How to use it
paragraphs: Print the sheet, look at every card first, then number them in the order the story happens. Retell the story aloud using first, next and last.

takeaway: Sequencing is comprehension you can touch: a reader who can order a story understands it.
materials: Safety scissors if you want to cut the cards out and shuffle them
supervision: Ask "what happened just before this one?" — it is the question that unlocks every sequence.
safetyNotes: Use child-safe scissors with rounded tips, and sit at a table while cutting. Keep small cut pieces away from children under 3 — they are a choking hazard.
Print at 100% size (not "fit to page") so the sheet keeps its true size and the pictures stay the size they were drawn.
screenFreeExtension: Retell the story to a stuffed animal audience at bedtime, in order, with voices.
